system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Use `{placeholder}` values in agent and task text, then set defaults in `crew.jsonc` under `inputs`.
system_prompt_style.note: Agent role/goal/backstory templates rendered with inputs; prompt customization documented at docs/edge/en/guides/advanced/customizing-prompts.mdx.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Add optional knowledge files in `knowledge/` and skill files in `skills/`.
env_context_strategy.note: General-purpose orchestration framework, no repo/environment context injected by default; knowledge/RAG tools are opt-in.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Compose agents with tools, memory, knowledge, and structured outputs using Pydantic.
observation_format.note: Multimodal agents documented (learn/multimodal-agents.mdx) but default tool outputs are text.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Add custom tools in `tools/` and reference them as `"custom:<name>"`.
edit_primitive.note: No editing tool attached by default; FileWriteTool/coding agents available as opt-in tools.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Agent-ready capabilities: Use tools, memory, knowledge, checkpointing, async execution, and MCP/A2A support for more capable production agents.
tool_schema_source.note: Tools defined as Python classes with Pydantic args schemas; MCP server tools documented under docs/edge/en/mcp/.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: async execution, and MCP/A2A support for more capable production agents

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: It gives developers autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows.
loop_primitives.note: Default crew process is sequential (fixed_pipeline of tasks); agents run a ReAct-style tool loop; Flows are event-driven.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the hierarchical process, which automatically assigns a manager to the defined crew to properly coordinate the planning and execution of tasks
planning_granularity.note: An opt-in `planning` feature exists (docs/edge/en/concepts/planning.mdx); not default.

multi_agent_topology.note: Default sequential process hands tasks between specialised agents; hierarchical (orchestrator_workers) is config-reachable.

delegation_mechanism.note: Delegation tools pass work to coworker agents in the same crew; allow_delegation is an agent setting.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Define sequential, hierarchical, or hybrid processes with guardrails, callbacks, and human-in-the-loop triggers.
human_in_loop.note: Task-level human_input review documented (learn/human-input-on-execution.mdx); off by default.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Secure, consistent state management between tasks
short_term_state.note: Flow state is a typed Pydantic model (e.g. MarketState in README example).

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Add tools, memory, checkpointing, and async execution as your system grows.
long_term_memory.note: Long-term/entity memory backed by storage (docs/edge/en/concepts/memory.mdx) and skills/ directory; memory is off by default.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Orchestrate start/listen/router steps, manage state, persist execution, and resume long-running workflows.
state_persistence.note: Checkpointing documented at docs/edge/en/concepts/checkpointing.mdx; not enabled by default.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Design agents, orchestrate crews, and automate flows with guardrails, memory, knowledge, and observability baked in.
self_verification.note: Task guardrails (incl. LLM-based) validate outputs; opt-in.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Define sequential, hierarchical, or hybrid processes with guardrails, callbacks, and human-in-the-loop triggers.
retry_policy.note: Guardrail failure triggers bounded retries (max_retries); inferred from prose.

rollback.evidence_quote: Secure, consistent state management between tasks
rollback.note: No revert mechanism for environment changes documented; checkpointing restores flow state only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Cost efficiency: optimized to minimize token usage and API calls
termination_condition.note: Agent max_iter caps the tool loop; task completion ends execution.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Optimized for speed and minimal resource usage, enabling faster execution.
cost_controls.note: max_rpm / max_tokens settings available on agents and LLMs.

timeouts.evidence_quote: Add deterministic steps, human input, structured outputs, and checkpointing as your system grows.
timeouts.note: Agent max_execution_time and tool timeouts configurable; not verifiable at line level from supplied evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: CrewAI is a standalone Python framework with its own primitives for agents, tasks, crews, flows, tools, and orchestration.
execution_isolation.note: Runs in-process in the host Python; sandbox tools (Daytona, E2B, CodeInterpreter) are opt-in tools.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Add custom tools in `tools/` and reference them as `"custom:<name>"`.
filesystem_access.note: Relative to host process; file tools access the host filesystem unrestricted.

network_policy.evidence_quote: CrewAI agents can easily integrate with external tools, APIs, and databases, empowering them to leverage real-world data and resources.
network_policy.note: No egress restriction mechanism found in supplied evidence.

permission_model.note: No per-call authorization by default; tool hooks (learn/tool-hooks.mdx) can block calls if configured.

tracing.evidence_quote: Users can disable telemetry by setting the environment variable OTEL_SDK_DISABLED to true.
tracing.note: Anonymous OTel telemetry on by default; many observability integrations documented.

replayability.note: Task replay from latest kickoff supported.

eval_hooks.note: `crewai test` evaluates crews; no external benchmark harness.

guardrails.evidence_quote: automate flows with guardrails, memory, knowledge, and observability baked in
guardrails.note: Task guardrails filter outputs; tool/execution hooks can block actions (docs/edge/en/learn/execution-boundary-hooks.mdx).

target_domain.evidence_quote: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents.
target_domain.note: Primarily general tool use; web-scraping/search tool families and coding agents docs shipped.

open_source.evidence_quote: CrewAI is released under the [MIT License]
open_source.note: AMP Suite commercial control plane is separate.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: CrewAI supports using various LLMs through a variety of connection options.
